s01-sofia-and-luis-swim.observed_description: At an outdoor pool with trees and a pale wall behind, Sofia (curly hair in a high bun, dark-blue swimsuit) and Luis (short dark curly hair, navy swim shorts) swim side by side toward the lower left, smiling; both faces are clear and match the reference.
s01-sofia-and-luis-swim.rejection: Both bodies lie on top of the water with bent legs and feet up in the air, as if sliding across the surface, so the swimming is not believable; they swim sideways across the frame, so the centered 4:5 crop cuts Sofia's hands and Luis's legs. Cause: the pool wording (body stretched out flat, feet off the bottom, low side camera). s02 shares that wording and is held for revision 2.

s03-sofia-and-luis-run.observed_description: On a wide paved path through a green park, Sofia (curly hair in a high bun, plain bright-blue running T-shirt, black leggings, white shoes) and tall Luis (short dark curly hair, plain navy T-shirt, dark-grey shorts, navy shoes) jog side by side toward the camera, elbows bent, smiling; seen whole from head to shoes, centered.
s03-sofia-and-luis-run.note: Usable. Jogging together reads at 180 px and both stay whole in the centered 4:5 crop; Luis's height matches 1.1. Their strides are short (Sofia's feet are close to the ground). Hands are natural fists; nothing is readable. A pale, out-of-focus shape far down the path is too indistinct to read as a person.

s04-diego-runs.observed_description: On a paved path through a green park, Diego (dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, plain burgundy running T-shirt, black shorts, grey shoes) jogs alone toward the camera mid-stride, one foot off the ground, elbows bent, smiling; seen whole from head to shoes, centered.
s04-diego-runs.note: Usable. Running reads instantly at 180 px; he stays whole in the centered 4:5 crop; matches his reference; hands natural; nobody else in the park; nothing readable.
